generation_parameters.prompt: Make a 6-column x 4-row transparent orthographic pixel-art atlas. Columns exactly front, top, right, left, bottom, rear. Rows exactly portal-active, portal-inactive, teleport-pad-active, teleport-pad-inactive in reference order. Each cell has one complete centered object. Match each exact original silhouette, palette, materials and details; paired active/inactive variants must remain the same design, changing only luminous/active state. True orthographic direction views, top straight down, bottom opposite, rear opposite front. No shadows, ground, scene, labels, perspective, border or cell markers. Crisp chunky pixel art; infer hidden surfaces consistently. Transparent background throughout.
